longDescription: Move project state between ChatGPT, Codex, chats, and agents without treating conversation summaries as truth. Project Continuity creates PCP/1 checkpoints, separates reported claims from verified evidence, checks integrity and repository drift when tools are available, reconciles external handoffs before execution, and prevents silent last-writer-wins updates. When repository access is unavailable, it degrades safely to portable checkpoints that must be reverified by the next capable surface.
capabilities: Create portable or repository-backed project checkpoints
Verify checkpoint integrity and completion evidence
Detect repository drift and divergent project state
Reconcile ChatGPT handoffs with Codex repository reality
Prevent unsupported completion claims and silent head overwrites
starterPrompts: Create a verified checkpoint for this project.
notes: Select the verified publisher identity in the OpenAI Platform portal.
Do not add app or MCP references to the Skills only submission.
The portal may normalize manifest fields after upload; review changes before confirmation.
